purpose: Replace three-rock period icons with one distinct-colored dinosaur fossil stone per period.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate one square transparent PNG for a young child's dinosaur geological-period picture clue. Polished friendly 3D storybook educational illustration. EXACTLY ONE chunky rounded irregular stone slab, broad almost-square front face viewed nearly straight on with slight thickness at right edge. The SINGLE stone occupies 86% of canvas width and 80% of height, centered, leaving a little empty bottom space for a caption the app will add. Two large contrasting cream-colored dinosaur fossil skeleton reliefs embedded flat INSIDE the front surface, arranged one above the other, each clearly legible at small card size, no overlapping skeletons. Fossil remains, no living dinosaurs. Simple large well-defined bones and recognizable species silhouettes rather than fussy fragments; scientific anatomy broadly plausible. Matte subtly textured rock, softened chipped edges, soft ambient lighting. Actual transparent alpha outside the stone. No other stones or pebbles, no plinth, plants, ground, background, shadows outside rock, ammonites, glowing outlines, words, numbers, letters, watermark, frame or label. This is LATE JURASSIC. Stone color is rich cool ocean BLUE/TEAL, uniform overall with gentle blue variations. Upper fossil: side-view Brontosaurus long-necked sauropod skeleton, extremely long gently curved neck and small head on left, huge barrel ribcage, four sturdy legs below, long tapering tail to right. Lower fossil: side-view Stegosaurus skeleton facing right, unmistakable large upright alternating bony plates along the back and four spikes at tail tip; small low head, four legs. Both skeletons fully inside the SAME SINGLE slab, made of warm ivory fossil bone. Do not include T. rex, Triceratops or any other dinosaurs.
